categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the P2P label and introduces net_processing tracker state (`StaleTipTracker`) as foundational infrastructure for BIP 332 stale tip relay.
categories.rationale: Implements local bounded tracking of stale tips to support BIP 332 stale tip relay, unblocking follow-up P2P network relay in #36920. BIP implementations and interoperability features represent durable strategic value for network relay.
